subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: AC#3 NOT MET — live_preview is dead code. setCommonConfig correctly destructures live_preview and calls (query as any).addParam('live_preview', live_preview.preview_hash), and createContentTypeQuery/createContentTypeEntryQuery correctly use rest operators (...commonConfig) to forward it. However, NONE of the public functions (getEntry, getSingleEntry, getAllContentTypeEntries, findSingletonEntry, getSingletonEntry) destructure or forward live_preview to createContentTypeQuery/createContentTypeEntryQuery. They all use explicit destructuring without a rest operator (e.g., getEntry destructures { contentTypeUid, referenceFieldPath, jsonRtePath, only, lang, includeFields }) so live_preview is silently dropped at every call site. The setCommonConfig live_preview handling is unreachable dead code — preview context can never flow through to Contentstack queries, directly contradicting AC#3 and prior review feedback: 'query config interfaces lack live_preview fields to forward preview context through to Contentstack queries'.
issues.suggestedFix: Add `...rest` (or explicit `live_preview`) to the destructuring of every public function and forward it to createContentTypeQuery/createContentTypeEntryQuery. E.g., in getEntry: `const { contentTypeUid, referenceFieldPath, jsonRtePath, only, lang, includeFields, ...rest } = params;` then pass `...rest` (or `live_preview: rest.live_preview`) to factory.createContentTypeQuery. Repeat for getSingleEntry, getAllContentTypeEntries, findSingletonEntry, getSingletonEntry.

issues.description: AC#4 NOT MET — No vitest unit tests exist for the live_preview feature. The test file has no tests covering: (1) live_preview block present with preview_token when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN is set, (2) live_preview absent when the token is unset, (3) setHost called with CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST when set, taking priority over CONTENTSTACK_API_HOST. Prior review feedback explicitly flagged missing tests as a rejection reason.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a describe('live_preview', ...) block with at least 3 tests: (1) Set CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN, require module, assert options.live_preview equals { enable: true, preview_token: <value> }. (2) Unset CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN, require module, assert options has no live_preview key. (3) Set both CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST and CONTENTSTACK_API_HOST, require module, assert Stack.setHost called with CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST (not API_HOST).

issues.description: No test verifies that live_preview context actually flows through a public function (getEntry, getSingleEntry, etc.) to the Contentstack query's addParam method. Since the forwarding code in setCommonConfig is dead code (see blocker above), no test can catch this regression. A test that calls getEntry (or similar) with a live_preview parameter and asserts that the mock's addParam method was called with the correct value is required to prove AC#3 is met.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a test that calls getEntry with live_preview: { enable: true, preview_hash: 'test_hash' } and asserts that the mock's addParam was called with ('live_preview', 'test_hash'). This requires adding addParam to the mock (see next issue).

issues.description: The Contentstack Stack mock does not include an addParam method. The setCommonConfig implementation calls (query as any).addParam('live_preview', live_preview.preview_hash). If the forwarding blocker above is fixed and any test passes live_preview through to setCommonConfig, the test will crash with 'addParam is not a function' because the mock object has no such method.
issues.suggestedFix: Add `addParam: jest.fn().mockReturnThis(),` to the jest.mock('contentstack') Stack factory mock object.
